answers.core: It's a fairly straightforward enhancement of an existing built-in mechanism and it makes a lot of sense for it to be integrated there.
answers.workaround: Theoretically you could do all this math and seek around in files manually, but I think it could be more robustly and intuitively done by extending the existing mechanism that already comes very close to doing this.

title: Allow AudioStreamInteractive to use BPM to transition between equivalent beats instead of only using absolute times
